mentions.name: Ad-skipping iOS podcast client
mentions.description: This iOS podcast client detects and skips ads automatically using an on-device model, letting the developer sell the app without a subscription. Version 2 will add support for video podcasts and YouTube podcasts.
mentions.problem: Podcast ads interrupt listening; on-device ad skipping enables selling the app without a subscription.
mentions.source_excerpt: I make a podcast client for iOS that detects and skips ads for you using an on device model. This allows me to sell without a subscription. I am working on v2 which will bring support for video podcasts and YouTube podcasts.
mentions.author: macinjosh
